citation: Old Settlers of Chicago, Seventh Annual Reception proceedings, 1883, deceased-members roster for Leonard C. Hugunin
locator: deceased old settlers roster: Leonard C. Hugunin — arrived Aug. 17, 1833
note: Near-primary old-settlers association proceedings. The roster gives Hugunin's exact name and Chicago arrival date; used with the 1839 directory for continuity, not to infer an unrecorded 1835 address or household.
